places.name: Lakshman Jhula
places.ai_summary: A historic suspension bridge over the Ganges River, offering scenic views and spiritual significance.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning or late evening.

places.place_tip: Avoid peak hours to escape the crowd.

opening_hours.notes: Less crowded in the early morning.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a trip to the nearby ashrams.

places.ai_summary: A serene ashram offering yoga, meditation, and the famous Ganga Aarti ceremony.

opening_hours.notes: Ganga Aarti starts at 6:00 PM daily.

places.place_tip: Attend the evening Ganga Aarti for a spiritual experience.

places.ai_summary: An abandoned ashram where The Beatles stayed, now a graffiti-filled tourist spot.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the morning hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the graffiti art and meditation halls.
places.address: The Beatles Ashram, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India

places.ai_summary: A sacred Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, located in the hills.

opening_hours.notes: Dress modestly and maintain silence inside the temple.

places.place_tip: Visit early morning for a peaceful experience.
places.address: Neelkanth Mahadev Temple, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India

places.place_tip: Visit during the early morning or late afternoon.
places.address: Tera Manzil Temple, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India

opening_hours.notes: Participate in the morning prayers for a spiritual experience.

places.place_tip: Engage in meditation or yoga sessions offered at the ashram.

places.name: Shivpuri (Rafting Hub)
places.ai_summary: A popular spot for white-water rafting and other adventure sports.

opening_hours.notes: Book rafting sessions in advance, especially in peak season.

places.place_tip: Carry extra clothes and towels if you plan to go rafting.

places.name: Rajaji National Park
places.ai_summary: A national park known for its wildlife, including elephants, tigers, and various bird species.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited with a guide; book a safari in advance.

places.place_tip: Visit the elephant rescue center if time permits.
places.address: Rajaji National Park, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India

places.name: Kaudiyala Rapids
places.ai_summary: Famous for white-water rafting, these rapids offer an adrenaline-pumping experience.

opening_hours.notes: Safety gear is provided by the rafting operators.

places.place_tip: Listen to your guide's safety instructions carefully.

places.name: Kunjapuri Devi Temple (Sunrise Point)
places.ai_summary: A temple situated at a hilltop, offering breathtaking views of the sunrise over the Himalayas.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise; dress warmly.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a trek in the surrounding hills.
places.address: Kunjapuri Devi Temple, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India

opening_hours.notes: Participate in the evening aarti for a spiritual experience.

places.place_tip: Maintain silence and respect the sanctity of the place.

opening_hours.notes: The cave can be slippery; wear appropriate footwear.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby ashrams.

places.place_tip: Participate in the yoga and meditation sessions offered.

places.name: Byasi River Camp
places.ai_summary: A riverside camp offering adventure activities and a peaceful retreat in nature.

opening_hours.notes: Ideal for camping enthusiasts and nature lovers.

places.place_tip: Book your stay in advance, especially on weekends.

places.name: Patna Waterfall
places.ai_summary: A beautiful waterfall located a short trek from the main road, offering a serene escape into nature.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited after the monsoon season.

places.place_tip: Carry water and snacks, as facilities are limited.

places.name: Neer Garh Waterfall
places.ai_summary: A picturesque waterfall requiring a short trek, known for its clear waters and scenic surroundings.

opening_hours.notes: Carry a camera for stunning photographs.

places.place_tip: Visit early to avoid crowds and enjoy the tranquility.
places.address: Neer Garh Waterfall, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India

places.name: Jumpin Heights (Bungee Jumping)
places.ai_summary: India's highest bungee jumping spot, offering an exhilarating experience for adventure seekers.

opening_hours.notes: Weight and age restrictions apply; book in advance.

places.place_tip: Not for the faint-hearted; ensure you meet the health requirements.

places.name: Riverside Market at Tapovan
places.ai_summary: A vibrant market along the Ganges, offering local handicrafts, food, and spiritual items.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for the night market.

places.place_tip: Bargain for handicrafts and try the local street food.
